panels.description: Physical Resource Block utilization for downlink and uplink across all cells

targets.query:
from(bucket: "oran-kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "oran_kpis")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "prb_utilization_dl" or r["_field"] == "prb_utilization_ul")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: 📶 PRB Utilization Trends

panels.description: Downlink and uplink throughput across all cells in Mbps

targets.query:
from(bucket: "oran-kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "oran_kpis")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "throughput_dl_mbps" or r["_field"] == "throughput_ul_mbps")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.description: Signal quality metrics: RSRP, RSRQ, and CQI values across cells

targets.query:
from(bucket: "oran-kpis")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "oran_kpis")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rsrp" or r["_field"] == "rsrq" or r["_field"] == "cqi")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: 📡 Signal Quality Metrics

panels.description: ML-based predictions vs actual values for key performance metrics

targets.query:
from(bucket: "oran-predictions")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "oran_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "predicted_load" or r["_field"] == "actual_load")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: 🔮 Load Predictions vs Actual

panels.description: Detected anomalies with their severity levels and affected metrics

targets.query:
from(bucket: "oran-anomalies")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "oran_anomalies")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
